attempts.sql: SELECT f.file_id AS file_path FROM code.files f WHERE f.is_test = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i JOIN code.files tf ON tf.file_id = i.file_id WHERE tf.is_test = true AND i.imported_file_id = f.file_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.files tf WHERE tf.is_test = true AND tf.file_id = regexp_replace(f.file_id, '(^|/)([^/]+)$', '\1test_\2')) ORDER BY f.file_id

request:
Which Python files that are not test files (every file under tests/, including helpers such as tests/common.py and conftest.py, is a test file) have no associated test file at all, meaning no test file imports that module directly (importing only the top-level httpx package counts as importing httpx/__init__.py, not its submodules) and no test file's name is exactly test_ followed by the source file's name (e.g. test_asgi.py for asgi.py; test_decoders.py does not match _decoders.py)? Give the repository-relative file paths.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: Selects non-test files that are neither imported directly by any test file nor matched by a test file named test_<basename> in the same directory. The regexp_replace builds the expected test path from the source path.
sql: SELECT f.file_id AS file_path FROM code.files f WHERE f.is_test = false AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i JOIN code.files tf ON tf.file_id = i.file_id WHERE tf.is_test = true AND i.imported_file_id = f.file_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.files tf WHERE tf.is_test = true AND tf.file_id = regexp_replace(f.file_id, '(^|/)([^/]+)$', '\1test_\2')) ORDER BY f.file_id
